Clams, potato, bacon and cream, with crackers.How to make it3 rashers of smoky bacon, chopped1 brown onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced2 tbsp plain flour400g potatoes, diced2 x 290g tins of baby clams, juice kept250ml milk250ml pouring cream2 thyme sprigs1 cup small salted crackersFry the bacon until crisp, then add the onion and celery and cook until soft.Stir in the flour for a minute, then whisk in the clam juice, milk and cream.Add the potatoes and thyme and simmer until the potatoes are tender.Stir in the clams, warm through and season with pepper.Ladle into cups and serve with the crackers.Kelly's-style roast beef three-way slidersThe Kelly's Roast Beef order. Rare beef, American cheese, barbecue sauce and mayo.How to make it400g rare roast beef, thinly sliced8 soft slider rolls8 slices of American cheese4 tbsp smoky barbecue sauce4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise125ml beef stockWarm the beef stock in a wide pan, add the sliced beef and heat through for 2 minutes without boiling.Split and lightly toast the rolls, then lay a slice of cheese on each base so it softens.Pile on the beef, then spoon over the barbecue sauce and a little mayo, Kelly's three-way style.Put the lids on and serve hot.Hot salted pretzels with brown mustardOn the bar for whoever's buying the next round.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsGame Six Fenway franksSean gave up his Game 6 seat for a girl. Mustard, relish and slow onions.How to make it8 beef frankfurts8 split-top bread rolls2 brown onions, thinly sliced20g butter4 tbsp yellow mustard4 tbsp sweet pickle relishCook the onions slowly in the butter with a pinch of salt until soft and golden.Grill or pan-fry the franks, turning, until blistered and hot through.Butter the flat sides of the buns and toast them in the pan until golden.Tuck the franks in and top with onions, mustard and relish.Southie corned beef and cabbageSunday dinner in Southie. Buttered cabbage, spuds and mustard cream.How to make it1.5kg corned silverside1 brown onion, halved2 bay leaves1 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp malt vinegar600g small potatoes3 carrots, cut in chunks1/2 green cabbage, cut in wedges40g butter150ml thickened cream2 tbsp hot English mustardRinse the silverside, cover with cold water and add the onion, bay leaves, sugar and vinegar.Bring to a gentle simmer and cook, barely bubbling, until a skewer slides in easily.Lift the beef out to rest and cook the potatoes and carrots in the liquid.Add the cabbage wedges for the last minutes, then drain and toss with the butter.Warm the cream with the mustard, slice the beef thickly and serve with the vegetables and mustard cream.DessertsCaramel apple crumble with vanilla custardHow do you like them apples?.
